lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 1 fix 001: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: US-R1-001 fixed the critical bug in pollPlannerDeath: added readPlannerReportFn?: () => unknown | null to RunPlanPhaseOptions. The poll now breaks when prd.json is written (primary signal) OR when the pane dies (fallback), mirroring the review.ts readReviewReport pattern. 6 new tests prove the AC4 completion path without pane death. The remaining story is US-R1-002 (WARNING: ADR 0004 contradicts the implemented code - references wrong symbols and wrong report filename).

officialDocsValidated.summary: US-R1-001 is an internal bug fix: mirrors the readReviewReport pattern from review.ts into plan-runner.ts. No external library API was exercised.
